maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from advertising, media, PR and marketing services for brands, not repair or maintenance of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are private brands and companies (consumer, healthcare, tech); advertising paid by commercial businesses, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through agency networks and media/advertising services; occasional large deals like the Interpublic merger don't make it a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Advertising, media and PR agency services are contract-based, and clients can re-tender agency accounts to rivals without regulatory or technical barriers.

notes: Switching agencies is moderately disruptive, but agency reviews are routine, so I judged it not mission-critical.
